title: R2-SEC2: Receiver Behavior restates rule it just cross-referenced
description: In draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00.md, the Peer/receipt Receiver Behavior section says 'using the same rule as the Sender Behavior' and then immediately re-states the full rule verbatim: 'if Chat.receiptSharing is present for that Chat, that value is used; otherwise PresenceStatus.receiptSharing applies.' The cross-reference phrase is self-defeating because the rule is repeated anyway. Suggested fix: delete the verbatim restatement after 'using the same rule as the Sender Behavior' — the forward reference is sufficient.
close_reason: Fixed: redundant restatement removed from Receiver Behavior (federation-00.md:315)
